Title: Arm's Length
Name: Arm's Length
Effect: This Artistry forces the target to take ten(10) steps away from the Caster and prevents them from approaching for its duration.

Title: Armour Trick
Name: Armour Trick
Effect: This Artistry improves the Physical Armour worn by the Caster by five(5) points. This ability does not stack with any other effects which Enhance Physical Armour.

Title: Armour Trick, Greater
Name: Armour Trick, Greater
Effect: This Artistry improves the Physical Armour worn by the Caster by ten(10) points. This ability does not stack with any other effects which Enhance Physical Armour.

Title: Armour Trick, Superior
Name: Armour Trick, Superior
Effect: This Artistry improves the Physical Armour worn by the Caster by twenty(20) points. This ability does not stack with any other effects which Enhance Physical Armour.

Title: Awakening Shout
Name: Awakening Shout
Effect: This Artistry instantly removes all Compulsions effects from the target. The following effects are Compulsions; Calm, Charm, Dominate, Fear, Shun, Silence, Sleep. This Artistry does not affect Enthral.

Title: Banishing Strike
Name: Banishing Strike
Effect: This Artistry forces the target Extraplanar creature or Elemental back to its home plane. A creature which has been affected by this effect cannot return to the plane from which it was Banished for twenty-four(24) hours. This Artistry only functions on Hymira and will fail if cast on any other Plane.

Title: Battle Meditation
Name: Battle Meditation
Effect: This Artistry instantly grants the target the benefits of having Meditated. This applies only to expended Skills which are recovered by Meditating.

Title: Binding Shot [Binding]
Name: Binding Shot
Effect: This Binding Artistry can be used only with a Thrown Weapon or the Archery Skill. This effect forces the target's arms to their sides and keeps them there throughout its duration. The creature cannot use any Skill which requires the use of their arms such as using weapons or casting Spells.

Title: Block
Name: Block
Effect: This Artistry can be used to negate a single attack causing Weapon Damage. It cannot be used against any <Effect>-Strike effect.

Title: Blood Feast
Name: Blood Feast
Effect: This Artistry can be cast only within ten(10) seconds of the delivery of a successful Killing Blow. This Spell causes ten(10) points of Physical Healing.

Title: Bloodied Reaver
Name: Bloodied Reaver
Effect: As an additional cost to cast this Artistry, the Caster must expend seven(7) Hit Points. The Caster may either deliver a Weapon Strike causing thirty(30) points of Piercing Physical Body or Piercing Physical Healing.
Delivery Verbal: "30 Piercing Physical-Strike Body" or "30 Piercing Physical-Strike Healing"

Title: Bloodied Weapon
Name: Bloodied Weapon
Effect: As an additional cost to cast this Artistry, the Caster must expend two(2) Hit Points. The Caster may either deliver a Weapon Strike causing five(5) points of Piercing Physical Body or Piercing Physical Healing.
Delivery Verbal: "5 Piercing Physical-Strike Body" or "5 Piercing Physical-Strike Healing"

Title: Bloodthirst
Name: Bloodthirst
Effect: This Artistry allows the Caster to instantly recover a single expended Skill. A target can benefit from this effect no more than once per Reset regardless of its source.

Title: Celerity
Name: Celerity
Effect: This Artistry instantly restores any Avoidance Armour the Caster possesses to full value.

Title: Charge
Name: Charge
Effect: This Artistry removes the Fetter effect from the Caster.

Title: Composure
Name: Composure
Effect: This Artistry causes twenty(20) points of Physical Healing to the Caster. Any healing above the Character's maximum is converted into Fortification Points.

Title: Courageous Voice
Name: Courageous Voice
Effect: This Artistry grants the Caster the ability to deliver, by Touch, a Physical Remove Fear effect at will. This effect ends if the Caster goes ten(10) seconds without affecting a new target or enters a state where they are unable to use Skills. No target can benefit from this effect more than once.

Title: Critical Slay
Name: Critical Slay
Effect: This Artistry allows the Caster to deliver a Weapon Attack causing fifty(50) points of damage appropriate to the Weapon Type of their weapon.

Title: Critical Strike
Name: Critical Strike
Effect: This Artistry allows the Caster to deliver a Weapon Attack causing thirty(30) points of damage appropriate to the Weapon Type of their weapon.

Title: Death Strike
Name: Death Strike
Effect: This Artistry allows the Caster to deliver a Weapon Attack which instantly kills the target, causing them to enter their Death Count.

Title: Deflect Energy
Name: Deflect Energy
Effect: As part of casting this Artistry the Caster chooses one of the following types; Acid, Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Stone. The Caster gains a shield against the next effect by which they are struck which causes the chosen type of damage.

Title: Defy Death
Name: Defy Death
Effect: This Artistry instantly restores the Dead target to life. The creature is no longer dead and is healed to one(1) Hit Point. If this Spell is cast upon a creature that is not Dead it has no effect but may be recovered by the Caster by Meditating.

Title: Delay Death
Name: Delay Death
Effect: This Artistry adds five(5) minutes to the target's Death Count up to a maximum of ten(10) minutes.

Title: Disabling Strike [Curse]
Name: Disabling Strike
Effect: This Curse Artistry allows the Caster to deliver a Physical-Strike Cripple effect affecting the limb of the Caster's choice. A Crippled arm cannot be used for any Skills and cannot hold any items. A Crippled leg cannot be used to walk and prevents the target from moving faster than a slow, limping walking pace. The target cannot hop. If both legs are Crippled the target can only kneel in place.

Title: Disarming Strike [Curse]
Name: Disarming Strike
Effect: This Curse Artistry prevents the target from using a single weapon chosen by the Caster, or using any Skill requiring the use of the weapon for its duration. If the target is wielding more than one weapon which matches the description named by the Caster it us up to the target which weapon is affected.

Title: Disorienting Shout
Name: Disorienting Shout
Effect: This Artistry prevents the target from running or even standing up right. The target cannot use any Skills and, additionally, cannot move without crawling.

Title: Draining Strike [Curse]
Name: Draining Strike
Effect: This Curse Artistry prevents the target from running or using any Skills until the effect ends or is removed.

Title: Elemental Fortress
Name: Elemental Fortress
Effect: This Artistry grants the Caster the ability to negate a single effect delivered as Elemental(-Strike) by which the target is struck. The target's player chooses when this ability activates.

Title: Elemental Guard
Name: Elemental Guard
Effect: This Spell negates the next effect delivered as Elemental(-Strike) by which the target is struck.

Title: Elemental Rune
Name: Elemental Rune
Effect: The Caster of this Artistry may, at a time of their choosing, trigger it allowing them to use one of the following damage types; Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Stone, for the duration of Combat. Combat is considered to be over when the Character goes one(1) minute without attacking, or being attacked by, an enemy.

Title: Escape
Name: Escape
Effect: This Artistry, which can be Cast without the need for a free hand, instantly removes all Binding effects from the Caster. The following effects are Binding; Bind, Confine, Pin, and Web. Please note that Confine prevents the target from using Skills and so this ability normally cannot be used while under its effects.

Title: Eviscerating Strike
Name: Eviscerating Strike
Effect: This Artistry allows the Caster to deliver a Weapon Attack causing fifty(50) points of damage appropriate to the Weapon Type of their weapon. In order to use this Artistry the Caster must be standing behind the target and able to see both the target's shoulder blades or expend a Charge of Ambush.

Title: Explosive Shot
Name: Explosive Shot
Effect: This Artistry can be used only with a Thrown Weapon or the Archery Skill. This Artistry Destroys the target item. A Destroyed item cannot be Repaired. Certain creatures, such as Constructs, may be damaged by this Spell. If the target has multiple items in their possession which match the description of the item designated by the Caster it is the target who chooses which of their items are affected. The target cannot choose an item which is Indestructible unless it is the only item they have which matches that description.

Title: Exposing Strike
Name: Exposing Strike
Effect: This Artistry allows the Caster to deliver a Weapon Attack causing thirty(30) points of damage appropriate to the Weapon Type of their weapon. In order to use this Artistry the Caster must be standing behind the target and able to see both the target's shoulder blades or expend a Charge of Ambush.

Title: Fettering Strike [Curse]
Name: Fettering Strike
Effect: This Curse Artistry prevents the target from running or jumping. The target must have at least one foot on the ground at all times and cannot move faster than a normal walking pace.

Title: Flare
Name: Flare
Effect: This Artistry creates a light source which allows the use of a diffused flash light, lantern, glow stick or similar light source. A light source may be disqualified from use if it is too bright. The decision as to whether or not a light can be used is up to the Marshal.

Title: Forceful Shout
Name: Forceful Shout
Effect: This Artistry causes fifteen(15) points of Physical Force damage to the target.

Title: Hammer Strike [Binding]
Name: Hammer Strike
Effect: This Binding Artistry prevents the target from moving their right foot from its position at the time they are affected by this effect. The target may pivot on this foot but can neither lift, nor move it.

Title: Heroic Stand
Name: Heroic Stand
Effect: This Artistry grants the Caster Physical Resistance. This effect reduces all damaging effects delivered as Physical(-Strike) by half as well as reducing the duration of all effects delivered as Physical(-Strike) to ten(10) seconds. This effect ends if the Character dies, enters a state where they are unable to use Skills, uses any other Artistry or Combat ends. Combat is considered to be over when the Character goes one(1) minute without attacking, or being attacked by, an enemy.

Title: Intimidating Display [Compulsion]
Name: Intimidating Display
Effect: This Compulsion Artistry allows the Caster to throw any number of packets. Any creature struck by one or more packets must immediately flee the Caster's presence attempting to break line of sight with them. They cannot use any Skills while under this effect. Once the target has broken line of sight with the Caster for ten(10) seconds they may again use their Skills but this effect remains active unless it ends or is removed. Until it does, if the target returns to the Caster's line of sight they again lose access to all Skills and must flee in an attempt to once again break line of sight.

Title: Intimidating Shout [Compulsion]
Name: Intimidating Shout
Effect: This Compulsion Artistry prevents the target from willingly approaching the Caster or attacking the Caster. This effect ends if the Caster attacks the target.

Title: Invigorating Shout
Name: Invigorating Shout
Effect: This Artistry removes, from the target, the Drain effect. Since a target cannot have multiple instances of the same effect, this removes all Drains from the target. When delivering this effect, the Character may throw any number of packets.

Title: Iron Hide
Name: Iron Hide
Effect: This Artistry grants the target a Ward allowing them to negate a single effect delivered as Physical(- Strike) by which they are struck. The target chooses when to activate this ability.

Title: Knockout Strike [Compulsion]
Name: Knockout Strike
Effect: This Compulsion Artistry allows the Caster to deliver a Lesser Physical-Strike Sleep effect preventing them from moving or using any Skills. This Artistry lasts ten(10) seconds.

Title: Magic Fortress
Name: Magic Fortress
Effect: This Artistry grants the Caster a Ward allowing them to negate a single effect delivered as Magic(-Strike) by which they are struck. The Caster chooses when to activate this ability.

Title: Magic Guard
Name: Magic Guard
Effect: This Artistry grants the Caster a Shield against the next effect delivered as Magic(-Strike) by which they are struck.

Title: Mortal Strike
Name: Mortal Strike
Effect: This Curse Artistry causes the target to take double damage from all sources. Additionally, the Character cannot use any form of the Defensive Ability Resist <Effect> or <Effect> Resistance.

Title: On Guard
Name: On Guard
Effect: This Artistry grants the Caster a Shield against the next effect delivered as Physical(-Strike) by which they are struck.

Title: Overcome
Name: Overcome
Effect: This Artistry instantly removes all harmful effects from the Caster which would be removed by the Caster's death. The Caster's player makes the determination as to which effects are harmful.

Title: Pain Strike
Name: Pain Strike
Effect: This Artistry allows the Caster to deliver a Strike causing ten(10) points of Physical Body damage.

Title: Paralysing Strike[Curse]
Name: Paralysing Strike[Curse]
Effect: This Curse Artistry completely immobilises the target preventing them from speaking, moving or using any Skills while in effect. This effect does not prevent the target from being moved.

Title: Perfect Counter
Name: Perfect Counter
Effect: This Artistry allows the Caster to cause a single effect delivered as <Effect>-Strike, or any attack causing Weapon Damage to be rebounded against their attacker. This Artistry is not cast in advance, it is simply expended in order to Reflect the effect.

Title: Phantasmal Footwork
Name: Phantasmal Footwork
Effect: This Artistry grants the Caster a Dodge against the next three(3) effects, delivered by Weapon or Packet, by which it is struck. Unlike the Dodge Skill, the Caster does not choose when this ability activates, it is automatically triggered as soon as the Caster is struck by an applicable effect.

Title: Pinning Shot [Binding]
Name: Pinning Shot
Effect: This Binding Artistry can be used only with a Thrown Weapon or the Archery Skill. This Binding Artistry prevents the target from moving their right foot from its position at the time they are affected by this effect. The target may pivot on this foot but can neither lift, nor move it.

Title: Poison Fortress
Name: Poison Fortress
Effect: This Artistry grants the Caster a Ward allowing them to negate a single effect delivered as Poison(-Strike) by which they are struck. The Caster chooses when to activate this ability.

Title: Preparation
Name: Preparation
Effect: This Artistry grants the Caster five(5) Fortification Points.These Fortification Points are always the first lost due to damage. Multiple effects which grant Fortification Points do not stack.

Title: Quick Refit
Name: Quick Refit
Effect: This Artistry instantly restores any Physical Armour the target possesses to its full value.

Title: Recuperation
Name: Recuperation
Effect: This Artistry causes the Caster to begin Regenerating. Upon being affected by this Artistry the Caster may immediately spend a sixty(60)-count to benefit from this effect. At the end of this count the Caster is restored to maximum Hit Points. This effect ends, without effect, if the Caster is affected by any damaging effect, uses any Skill, or moves faster than a normal walking pace.

Title: Restore Wounds
Name: Restore Wounds
Effect: This Artistry causes ten(10) points of Physical Healing to the target. Any healing above the Character's maximum is lost.

Title: Restore Wounds, Greater
Name: Restore Wounds, Greater
Effect: This Artistry causes twenty(20) points of Physical Healing to the target. Any healing above the target's maximum is lost.

Title: Shattering Strike
Name: Shattering Strike
Effect: This Artistry Breaks the target item. A Broken item cannot be used until it is Repaired. Certain creatures, such as Constructs, may be damaged by this Artistry. If the target has multiple items in their possession which match the description of the item designated by the Caster it is the target who chooses which of their items are affected. The target cannot choose an item which is Indestructible unless it is the only item they have which matches that description.

Title: Shield Wall
Name: Shield Wall
Effect: Upon casting this Artistry, the Caster must cross both arms across their chest and can move at no faster than a walking pace. So long as both these requirements are met, the Caster is immune to all Weapon Damage and <Effect>-Strikes. This effect automatically ends after ten(10) seconds.

Title: Silencing Strike [Compulsion]
Name: Silencing Strike
Effect: This Compulsion Artistry prevents the target from speaking or casting Spells with an Incantation. Additionally, the target cannot intentionally create any sound such as clapping or using a noise making tool.

Title: Spell Reflection
Name: Spell Reflection
Effect: This Artistry causes the next effect, delivered as Magic(-Strike), by which the target is struck, to rebound against its Caster. The call for this effect, when triggered, is "Reflect".

Title: Spellbreaker
Name: Spellbreaker
Effect: This Artistry instantly removes all effects which were delivered as Magic(-Strike) from the target.

Title: Stalker's Cunning
Name: Stalker's Cunning
Effect: This Artistry grants the target two(2) points of Cunning, increasing their Weapon Damage, when behind their target by two(2). The Cunning from this effect does not stack with any other source.

Title: Stalker's Eye
Name: Stalker's Eye
Effect: This Artistry grants the target the ability to use any Skill, which requires the target to be behind the target, regardless of their position.

Title: Stunning Strike [Compulsion]
Name: Stunning Strike
Effect: This Compulsion Artistry causes the target to enter into a magical sleep preventing them from moving or using any Skills. As soon as it is safe to do so, the target must lay down as if asleep. The target is not considered Conscious.

Title: Terrifying Shout [Compulsion]
Name: Terrifying Shout
Effect: This Compulsion Artistry causes the target to immediately flee the Caster's presence attempting to break line of sight with them. They cannot use any Skills while under this effect. Once the target has broken line of sight with the Caster for ten(10) seconds they may again use their Skills but this effect remains active unless it ends or is removed. Until it does, if the target returns to the Caster's line of sight they again lose access to all Skills and must flee in an attempt to once again break line of sight.

Title: Terrifying Strike [Compulsion]
Name: Terrifying Strike
Effect: This Compulsion Artistry causes the target to immediately flee the Caster's presence attempting to break line of sight with them. They cannot use any Skills while under this effect. Once the target has broken line of sight with the Caster for ten(10) seconds they may again use their Skills but this effect remains active unless it ends or is removed. Until it does, if the target returns to the Caster's line of sight they again lose access to all Skills and must flee in an attempt to once again break line of sight.

Title: Thundering Strike
Name: Thundering Strike
Effect: As part of casting this Artistry the Caster chooses one of the following types; Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Stone. This Artistry causes ten(10) Physical-Strike damage of the chosen type.

Title: Titan's Scream
Name: Titan's Scream
Effect: This Artistry allows the Caster to throw any number of packets causing ten(10) points of Physical Force damage to any creature struck by one or more packets.

Title: Triage
Name: Triage
Effect: This Artistry instantly Stabilises a Dying creature putting them up to zero(0) Hit Points. This Artistry has no effect on a creature that is not Dying.

Title: Triple Strike
Name: Triple Strike
Effect: This Artistry grants the Caster the ability to deliver three(3) Physical-Strikes, each causing twenty(20) points of damage of the Weapon Type of the weapon used to deliver them. Once this Artistry is cast, the Caster has ten(10) seconds to use all charges or any remaining charges are lost. If this Artistry benefits from the Assassin Tradition, Echo, or similar effects, it applies to all Charges, but the Character must meet any requirements for the benefit for each attack.

Title: Twin Strike
Name: Twin Strike
Effect: This Artistry grants the Caster the ability to deliver two(2) Physical-Strikes, each causing ten(10) points of damage of the Weapon Type of the weapon used to deliver them. Once this Artistry is cast, the Caster has ten(10) seconds to use all charges or any remaining charges are lost. If this Artistry benefits from the Assassin Tradition, Echo, or similar effects, it applies to all Charges, but the Character must meet any requirements for the benefit for each attack.

Title: Twin Strike, Greater
Name: Twin Strike, Greater
Effect: This Artistry grants the Caster the ability to deliver two(2) Physical-Strikes, each causing fifteen(15) points of damage of the Weapon Type of the weapon used to deliver them. Once this Artistry is cast, the Caster has ten(10) seconds to use all charges or any remaining charges are lost. If this Artistry benefits from the Assassin Tradition, Echo, or similar effects, it applies to all Charges, but the Character must meet any requirements for the benefit for each attack.

Title: Twin Strike, Superior
Name: Twin Strike, Superior
Effect: This Artistry grants the Caster the ability to deliver two(2) Physical-Strikes, each causing twenty(20) points of damage of the Weapon Type of the weapon used to deliver them. Once this Artistry is cast, the Caster has ten(10) seconds to use all If this Artistry benefits from the Assassin Tradition, Echo, or similar effects, it applies to all Charges, but the Character must meet any requirements for the benefit for each attack. charges or any remaining charges are lost.

Title: Vorpal Finisher
Name: Vorpal Finisher
Effect: This Artistry grants the target the ability to cause five(5) additional points of damage with their next five(5) weapon attacks. The target can continue calling this bonus damage until they successfully land a valid strike on their target. Once all of these Charges are consumed, the Caster may deliver a Physical-Strike Causing twenty-five(25) points of damage of the Weapon Type of the weapon used to deliver them. If this Artistry benefits from the Assassin Tradition, Echo, or similar effects, it applies only to the final Physical-Strike.

Title: Vorpal Strike
Name: Vorpal Strike
Effect: This Artistry grants the target the ability to cause five(5) additional points of damage with their next weapon attack. The target can continue calling this bonus damage until they successfully land a valid strike on their target.

Title: Vorpal Strike, Greater
Name: Vorpal Strike, Greater
Effect: This Artistry grants the target the ability to cause five(5) additional points of damage with their next three(3) weapon attacks. The target can continue calling this bonus damage until they successfully land a valid strike on their target.

Title: Vorpal Strike, Superior
Name: Vorpal Strike, Superior
Effect: This Artistry grants the target the ability to cause five(5) additional points of damage with their next five(5) weapon attacks. The target can continue calling this bonus damage until they successfully land a valid strike on their target.

Title: Wall of Blades
Name: Wall of Blades
Effect: Upon casting this Artistry, the Caster must cross both arms across their chest and can move at no faster than a walking pace. So long as both these requirements are met, the Caster is immune to all Weapon Damage and <Effect>-Strikes.

Title: Weakening Strike [Curse]
Name: Weakening Strike
Effect: This Curse Artistry prevents the target from using Martial Arts with a Range of Strike, and Skills requiring the use of weapons, except Weapon Proficiencies. The target may still cast Spells which are delivered as <Delivery Type>-Strike.
